notes.title: Beta 1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/8a16e720966e57fa22fed191676fec6c0a398c71.png
The update is now live!

Changes:

 - Surfing improved and it is now smoother and feels better
 - Your time won't be uploaded as it is unfair


Look out for:
- The surfing levels aren't yet adjusted to the new mechanics so they may feel unnatural/incorrect.


 How to play the beta:

Go to your steam library and opt in there in the settings.

notes.title: What's next for BSurfing?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40755745/d652fcdae71ca0cdd02622d85b5a01a2e7a5b6e3.png
Hi everyone! 
The launch was a big success, thanks to everyone!
Through feedback I have realised that the surfing part wasn't as great as the bhop, so I'm going to improve surfing. 

Teaser of the upcoming update!
First content update: The World Update

 Featuring 50+ new skins (knives with countries from all around the world)
 5 new bhop maps, each map will be themed after a city from around the world.
 5 new surf maps, each map will be themed after a city from around the world.


A beta will be soon announced and live with the new surfing mechanics


What's coming to BSurfing in the future:

 Multiplayer
 And a level editor with workshop support


Till next time!

notes.title: Update version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
Leaderboard bugs:

 - Leaderboard didn't load if you didn't complete the level. Now it does load as it should.


UI:

 - Tab is highlighted blue to be more clear where you currently are.


New Features:
- Click on anyone on the leaderboards and their profile will open!
Leaderboards should now work completely

notes.title: Update version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
[olist]

[/olist]

New feature:
[olist]

[/olist]
